review_method: Direct native display of all three1024x1024 step375 PNG sheets and all three250 sheets; each is4x4 native256px samples. PNG decoding and hashing only, no tensor/model load or generator computation.

observations: Black neck regions and white tab/chin patches are now more prominent, but they often sit implausibly on the lower face rather than a shirt collar.
Mouths, teeth, cheeks and eyes are more distorted than at250 across much of the sheet; r1c1 and r2c3 have crushed or hollow mouths, and r3c2 has an abnormally stretched mouth/chin.
The childlike r1c3 and multiple female-presenting source identities remain; no reliable adult-male-only distribution is established.
Backgrounds and upper hair remain more source-like than the raw generator; this identity variety does not compensate for severe facial deformation.

Most tiles have black clerical shirts, white tabs, adult masculine presentation, and increasingly legible beards/skin relative to250. Some individual eyes/mouths are more coherent, although gray stylized rendering and uneven facial contours remain.
NEW MAJOR REGRESSION: r4c3 and r4c4 have large architectural/bar-like background patterns through or over the face, removing substantial facial structure. Both faces were recognizable at250.
Elsewhere geometry remains uneven, including cheek/mouth distortions and abnormal eyes; the two catastrophic tiles preclude interpreting the checkpoint as a general quality improvement.
Dark hair, related face proportions, mild smiles and architecture dominate. No obvious hats in these sixteen fixed samples; neither no-hat safety nor broad diversity is established.
Compared with250, source identities acquire larger distorted cheek/mouth regions and implausible chin/neck patches; faces are not dependable photographs.
The childlike r1c3, multiple female-presenting faces, glasses and the r3c2 microphone remain. This is still a mixed source/adapted distribution.

The fixed architectural patterns wiping out raw r4c3/r4c4 are not present in the same way in EMA; EMA has its own severe interpolation-like appearance, with mangled mouths and patchy lower faces. This is a visual description, not a claim about the generation mechanism.

comparison_to_250: Mixed and concerning: most raw portraits improve in local legibility, but two acquire catastrophic face/background structure failures; EMA dark clothing/tab adaptation comes with much worse facial distortion and still unsuitable source categories. No variant supports production use.
interpretation: This review supports flagging a new local failure, not declaring irreversible mode collapse from one fixed-latent grid.
A short further checkpoint can test whether the raw architecture-through-face failure is transient only if root chooses to continue; the evidence does not justify an open-ended unchanged run.
EMA lag is not evidence that these defects will resolve, nor a reason to substitute EMA for raw quality review.
scope_limits: No tensor loading, validation, inference, optimizer update, or signal was performed.
No active code, model, inputs or checkpoints changed.
Only this new review and the separate requested CI evidence were written.
